cases.command: WPS Commercial COM: open/export generated DOCX and PPTX; inspect every exported page/slide
cases.environment: Windows 11 Pro 10.0.26200 x64 / WPS Office Commercial 12.1.0.28022
cases.observedResult: WPS opened native editable files and exported readable 10-slide PPTX, 2-page student DOCX, and 2-page teacher DOCX; these were not outline-only or screenshot-only substitutes.

cases.command: WPS Presentation COM: open generated PPTX, edit title text, save, close, reopen, and verify marker and slide count
cases.environment: Windows 11 Pro 10.0.26200 x64 / WPS Office Commercial 12.1.0.28022
cases.observedResult: The first-slide title remained editable, the WPS compatibility marker persisted after save and reopen, and the presentation retained all 10 slides.

cases.command: WPS Writer COM: open student DOCX read-only, export to PDF, render both pages, and inspect task response spaces
cases.environment: Windows 11 Pro 10.0.26200 x64 / WPS Office Commercial 12.1.0.28022
cases.observedResult: The two-page student handout rendered without clipping and provided task-specific response areas, including an expanded writing area for the transfer task.

cases.command: WPS Writer and Presentation COM: export student DOCX and PPTX separately, render, and compare structures
cases.environment: Windows 11 Pro 10.0.26200 x64 / WPS Office Commercial 12.1.0.28022
cases.observedResult: The student handout was independently laid out by learning task with readable prompts and writing space; it was not a sheet of slide thumbnails.

cases.command: WPS Writer COM: open teacher DOCX, export to PDF, render both pages, and inspect answer boundaries, misconceptions, and follow-up prompts
cases.environment: Windows 11 Pro 10.0.26200 x64 / WPS Office Commercial 12.1.0.28022
cases.observedResult: The two-page teacher handout rendered without clipping and included evidence-based acceptable variants, insufficient examples, explanation boundaries, and teacher follow-up prompts.

cases.command: WPS Writer COM: open teacher DOCX, export to PDF, render, and inspect the missing-source downgrade and source-bound task content
cases.environment: Windows 11 Pro 10.0.26200 x64 / WPS Office Commercial 12.1.0.28022
cases.observedResult: With no imported curriculum-standard or local-exam source, the rendered teacher file retained explicit source-verification limits and did not invent official clause numbers, exam weights, quotations, or textbook page claims.
